title: Automated real-process J1 loop e2e
description: Objective: turn the manual 2026-08-09/10 live proof into an automated gate. Measured at HEAD 1aa7cdc: grep for daemon-main|startDaemon|agent-wrapper|mcp-main across tests/e2e/ returns ZERO — tests/e2e/foundation spawns only process.execPath with inline node -e stubs (e2e-process.ts:96, e2e-harness.test.ts:185); the full-loop evidence is docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:4-8 (manual). Deliverable: one e2e test (new file under tests/e2e/foundation/ or tests/integration/) that spawns the REAL daemon (daemon-main.ts with scratch store) and the REAL wrapper (agent-wrapper-main.ts with MOE_WRAPPER_ONCE=1 and MOE_AGENT_COMMAND pointed at a scripted fake agent — a small node script that connects to the wrapper's loopback MCP host with its scoped credential and drives one node implement->review.submit), seeds via the demo seed script (sibling task, order 2 — hard dependency, do not duplicate its logic), and asserts on the DURABLE LEDGER (events read from the store or /events/read) that the node reached COMMITTED through the review path. Kill both processes at teardown; no orphans (Windows taskkill semantics as in verifier-process-launcher.ts:49). NOT in scope: real claude children in CI; canary DoD items (epic-bd387eeb task-97554aa4 owns those); harness redesign. Verification: the new e2e passes locally from PowerShell with a nonzero executed-test count; pnpm typecheck exits 0. Depends on: demo bootstrap seed script task (same epic).
definitionOfDone: The e2e spawns real daemon-main and agent-wrapper-main child processes (asserted by checking their pids/origins, not stubs) and completes one node implement->review->COMMITTED, asserted from the durable event ledger, not from process stdout.
The fake agent authenticates with the per-agent scoped credential minted by the wrapper and drives only wired MCP commands; a forged/absent credential arm asserts the exact refusal code and layer.
Teardown kills daemon + wrapper + fake agent with no orphan processes on Windows, asserted by a post-run process check.
The suite runs from PowerShell with a nonzero executed-test count line and exits 0; pnpm typecheck exits 0; only explicit owned paths committed.
taskRails: Hard dependency: the demo bootstrap seed script task in this epic must be DONE first; reuse it, never reimplement the seeding.
Real processes only - no injected dispatch ports, no in-process daemon; the test's value is the process boundary.
No real claude spawns in the automated run; MOE_AGENT_COMMAND points at the scripted fake agent.
Assert the reason code, not just the outcome, on every refusal arm.

implementationPlan.note:
PART A — THE BLOCK IS CLOSED, MEASURED LIVE, NOT INFERRED.

Fields TRANSCRIBED from the readers, never guessed:
- calibration slice = the exact 4 keys parseSlice admits (reviewer-calibration-record.ts SLICE_KEYS): corpusRevision, sentinelPassed, sliceRef, staleness. Extra/missing key -> REVIEWER_CALIBRATION_UNREADABLE.
- verifier policy slice = sliceRef + the core's exact 13 INPUT_KEYS (policy-validation.ts). readVerifierPolicy strips sliceRef, runs evaluatePolicy, and requires ALLOW + action integration.accept_output + actor daemon:node-verifier. ALLOW needs all four fold layers: one DAEMON_VERIFIED R0 tier-bearing fact (else RISK_TIER_UNCLASSIFIABLE -> HOLD_UNKNOWN), no rules/required facts, and an autoApprovalOptIn naming THAT action at >= the derived tier (design 710). decisionDigest/policyRevisionRef are hex64; evaluatedAtEpochMs is a fixed literal because the module must stay clock-free and byte-identical for replay.

Wiring: demo-seed-plan.ts gains two policy.install commands between project.activate and goal.create on the `${projectId}-policy` stream at expectedVersion 0 then 1, plus an idSuffix on frozenCommand — the durable decision key is (commandId, principalId, projectId), so two installs under one id would make the SECOND A REPLAY of the first: the calibration would never be written and the seed would still print success. DEMO_SEED_KINDS carries both entries.

planningNotes.risks: (1) The spawner's Windows quoting rules for MOE_AGENT_COMMAND are the biggest unknown — step 1 measures agentSpawnInvocation; the .cmd-shim fallback is specified and generated into SCRATCH (never committed). (2) The wrapper claims EVERY ready item in ONCE mode — if the seed creates more than one agent-claimable step, the fake agent may be spawned multiple times; the fake agent must be idempotent per mission and the test must await wrapper exit, not first-agent exit. (3) Real-process e2e under fleet load: generous 120s+ per-it timeouts from the start (the a3e8a02d QA reject was exactly a timeout flake); if the suite is load-sensitive, run it serially (vitest --no-file-parallelism for this file if needed). (4) Ephemeral port parse: read the daemon's banner line with a timeout and fail with the captured stdout on miss — never retry on a guessed port. (5) Orphan check must harvest the AGENT pid too — have the fake agent write a pidfile into scratch as its first act. (6) taskkill exits nonzero when the pid is already gone — treat already-dead as success in teardown, then assert absence via tasklist. (7) tests/e2e tsconfig may have strict lint rules — mirror sibling file style. (8) The forged-credential arm must present a WELL-FORMED bearer so the refusal comes from the authenticator (pin its code), not a transport 400 — the deviation fixture must be valid at earlier layers.

reviewSummary:
APPROVED - 4 DoD re-measured at commit 111fb21.

GATES I RE-RAN (PowerShell): `pnpm test:e2e` -> 0, `Test Files 6 passed (6)` / `Tests 77 passed (77)`; focused verbose run of the new file -> 3 passed with a fresh acceptedVerifierReceiptId 90127d4c... unlike the worker's, so ledger data is produced per run, not transcribed. `pnpm --recursive --no-bail typecheck` -> 0, zero error lines: repo-wide is genuinely green, so DoD 4 is met literally.

MY DRILL, not the worker's: flipped the seed's `sentinelPassed: true` -> false. The seed still installs, so this attacks the AUTHORITY chain, not the plumbing -> the complete arm reds on `expected undefined to be defined` (acceptedReceiptId), 1 failed | 2 skipped. Proves the COMMITTED verdict hangs on real daemon-side verifier authority and the calibration slice is load-bearing. Restored byte-identical sha256 a92486c0..., porcelain clean, HEAD unmoved, e2e green after.

DoD1: READY receipt PARSED and matched to the spawned pid/projectId/storePath; COMMITTED read from the store FILE after every process is dead - review ledger + receipt row keyed to daemon:node-verifier + VerifierReceiptRecorded count.
DoD2: submit attributed to the scoped sess-wrap-* principal, not operator-local; the forged arm asserts the PARSED body (-32001, AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, REAUTHENTICATE, UNAUTHENTICATED/401), and refusalBody() throws when no refusal line exists, so it cannot match over {}.
DoD3: the orphan check is preceded by its own positive control (pidIsAlive(process.pid) === true); without it the probe's fail-open catch would pass over a probe that can only answer "gone".
DoD4: 9 files; both foreign extensions authorized by amendments and disclosed in the commit body.

FLAGGED, not rejected: sentinelPassed:true declares a sentinel corpus the demo never ran - accepted because an unproven record makes COMMITTED unreachable and it is self-declaring via corpusRevision. agent-wrapper-main.ts is now 396 lines, 4 under the cap.
